### EAFIT's signing process

The signing of the agreement by the Vice-Rector for Academic Affairs, legal representative of Universidad EAFIT.

- (Responsable) Internacionalization EAFIT
- Estimated time: 15 business days after the delivery of all documents.

- Documents:

  - The academic responsible for the agreement at EAFIT must sign both the agreement and the Approval for Agreement Signing Form.

### Signing process by the partner institution

The partner signs the agreement received from Universidad EAFIT

- (Responsable): Partner Institution
- Estimated time\*: About 1 month after the signed agreement was sent.

\*This deadline depends entirely on the timing of the international institution.

### Review by the legal department of Universidad EAFIT

Review of the final version of the agreement by the University's legal department.

- (Responsable): legal department of Universidad EAFIT
- Estimated time: 5 business days after the reception of the final version of the agreement.

\[In case the legal department requires a new version of the document with adjustments or modifications, the process will return to Stage 3 - Partner Review\].

### Review by Universidad EAFIT

\- Review of the request and the profile of the international institution - Drafting the preliminary agreement template

- (Responsible): Internacionalization EAFIT

(and academic responsible if necessary)

- Estimated time: 15 business days after the initial request.

### Review by international partner institution

Review of the draft agreement by the international partner Institution

- Responsible: international partner institution
- Estimated time\*: Approximately 1 month after the document is submitted by EAFIT.

\*This deadline depends entirely on the review process and the timing of the international institution. \[In the event that the partner proposes a new version of the document with adjustments or modifications, the process will return to Stage 2 - EAFIT Review\].

### Agreement request

The request can be made by a professor, administrative staff of EAFIT, or an international institution.

- (Person in charge): International Institution or professor/staff member of EAFIT

- Estimated time: with 3 months in advance

- Required documentation: e-mail and agreement request form.

Email address agreements@eafit.edu.co

[Partner with us​​ ​](https://www.eafit.edu.co/internacionalizacion/global-engagement#230548828-2065644403)

Universidad EAFIT focuses its partnerships on a smaller number of key institutions for closer collaboration. These partnerships usually involve joint programs, co-funded research, faculty, and student mobility.​

As mentioned above, EAFIT establishes strategic relationships with high-quality national and international partners, with whom we share our core values and develop unique long-term partnerships that contribute to:

Fulfill both institutions' mission. ​

Offer students, faculty, and staff a wide range of opportunities to enhance their international competencies and reach.

Support capacity building with an institutional scope.​

Our international partnerships span a diverse range of countries, languages, and objectives, established under the following principles:​

Reciprocity​

Trust

Commitment

Sustainability
